'''Pillaat and Nerro''' was a [[Troig/Legends|Troig]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Bartender/Legends|bartender]] who worked in the [[Spyder]], a gambling establishment located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Pillaat and Nerro encountered a band of [[Pyke Syndicate/Legends|Pyke Syndicate]] operatives who had ventured to the Spyder while searching for the [[Nikto/Legends|Nikto]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Kaa'to Leeachos]].<ref name="UABS" />
